environment.scope: Managed SDK development qualification on this Linux host; scripted fixture/native X11 only, not an authenticated provider or physical-device claim.

dev_identity_and_geometry.criteria: Runtime and protocol tests prove stable semantic identity and frame-bound transformed video-coordinate geometry.
dev_identity_and_geometry.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

dev_displayed_canvas_selection.criteria: GPUI-free canvas and shell tests refuse stale image/frame identities and preserve overlap and rectangle semantics.
dev_displayed_canvas_selection.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

dev_source_retrieval_and_tools.criteria: Hash-verified syntax retrieval and shared read-only tool dispatch pass boundedness and revision-fence tests.
dev_source_retrieval_and_tools.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

dev_frozen_canvas_task_scope.criteria: Element and rectangle selections freeze typed identity, geometry and explicit uncertainty without fabricating source anchors.
dev_frozen_canvas_task_scope.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

dev_managed_sdk_title_lookup.criteria: A generated starter title renders through the verified managed SDK and resolves its registered object tuple and explicit source anchor.
dev_managed_sdk_title_lookup.notes: Generated starter title rendered and its explicit source anchor resolved against immutable Rust source.

dev_native_linux_canvas.criteria: Native X11 input selects the managed title from measured frame geometry and exercises cycling, zoom, pan and nonsemantic rectangle scope.
dev_native_linux_canvas.notes: Xvfb native input selected the measured managed-title bounds and exercised zoom, pan, cycling and rectangle scope. Screenshots are included as evidence.

dev_resource_bounds_and_cleanup.criteria: Measure bounded source-index and hit-test workloads, and verify cancellation and owned resource teardown.
dev_resource_bounds_and_cleanup.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

dev_full_title_edit_apply_undo_reopen.criteria: A selected managed-SDK title completes prompt, candidate validation, Apply, Undo and reopen with matching before/after identity evidence.
dev_full_title_edit_apply_undo_reopen.notes: Bounded test evidence recorded by the M5 runner.

auth_provider_title_edit_undo_reopen.criteria: An authenticated ACP provider completes a selected title edit, Apply, Undo and reopen with safe writer teardown.
auth_provider_title_edit_undo_reopen.notes: No authentic provider run was attempted; scripted peers cannot satisfy this gate.
auth_provider_title_edit_undo_reopen.prerequisite: Use an operator-authenticated ACP provider and run the complete selected-title lifecycle.

auth_physical_display_input.criteria: A real Linux device proves displayed-frame semantic selection, source-anchor resolution and physical display/input behavior.
auth_physical_display_input.notes: Xvfb is development-only evidence and does not qualify physical display/input.
auth_physical_display_input.prerequisite: Run the native selection workflow on a physical Linux display/input device.

auth_windows.criteria: A Windows run proves displayed-frame semantic selection and hash-verified source-anchor retrieval through the managed SDK.
auth_windows.notes: No Windows host is available in this environment.
auth_windows.prerequisite: Run the complete M5 development workflow on a Windows host with native input.

auth_macos.criteria: A macOS run proves displayed-frame semantic selection and hash-verified source-anchor retrieval through the managed SDK.
auth_macos.notes: No macOS host is available in this environment.
auth_macos.prerequisite: Run the complete M5 development workflow on a macOS host with native input.

acceptance.reason: M5 development gates pass. Full acceptance remains pending authentic provider, physical-device, Windows and macOS evidence.
